description: This file defines API routes for managing user sessions and messages in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting sessions, as well as posting messages within sessions. It interacts with a Supabase backend for data storage and retrieval.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client instance using environment variables for configuration.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all sessions for the current user, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new session associated with the current user.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific session and its messages, confirming ownership.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update a session's title, ensuring user ownership.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a session, confirming user ownership.

methods.name: post_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to submit a message to a session, validating session ownership and presence of files, then creating an assistant reply stub.
